title: Pakwan
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,semolina,ghee,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,sooji,ghee aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and knead until firm dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ghond ker firm dough tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Cover and let it rest for 15-20 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Dhak ker 15-20 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Grease hand with oil and knead dough again until smooth.
steps.romanUrdu: Haath ko oil sa grease karein aur dough ko smooth hunay tak dubara ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Take a small dough and make a ball,sprinkle flour and roll out dough with the help of rolling pin & prick with fork (makes 7-8).
steps.romanUrdu: Chota dough lein aur ball bana lein,maida chirak ker rolling pin ki madad sa dough ko bail lein aur fork ki madad sa prick karein (makes 7-8).

steps.instruction: In wok,heat cooking oil and fry until golden & crispy.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein cooking oil garam karein aur golden & crispy hunay tak fry ker lein.

ogDescription: Home made Pakwan recipe. have it with halwa or have it with daal. #HappyCookingToYou #Daal #Pakwan
